name: Hong Kong Shue Yan University
summary: North Point university on Braemar Hill with 20 four-year bachelor's programmes in four faculties; an IB Diploma of 24 points qualifies.

ib.text: IB Diploma with at least 24 points; English shown by IB English grade 4 (HL or SL), IELTS 5.5 or TOEFL iBT 79. Non-local applicants also show Chinese proficiency; some programmes need Cantonese.

dates.label: Non-local IB applicants: complete qualification documents due

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts
faculties.line: Chinese, English, History and arts degrees; Chinese Language and Culture and History ask for competence in written and spoken Chinese.

faculties.name: Faculty of Commerce
faculties.line: Business Administration, Digital Marketing and Economics and Finance; the general 24-point IB rule applies.

faculties.name: Faculty of Communication, Information and Creative Industries
faculties.line: Journalism and Mass Communication, game applications and media design degrees; the general 24-point IB rule applies.

faculties.name: Faculty of Social Sciences
faculties.line: Psychology, counselling, criminology and social work; Social Work and Counselling ask for Chinese writing and Cantonese dialogue.

notes: All first-year students take Chinese and Culture courses; non-local students whose first language is not Chinese take Chinese culture subjects taught in English.
HKSYU teaches in English and Chinese depending on the programme, so ask the admissions office which degrees run in English before you apply.
The non-local application fee is HK$650; HKSYU's non-local tuition for 2027/28 is not published yet, so ask the admissions office.
